introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all tasks (Task I, Task II, Task III) in this question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two and Group Three (booklets GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1, Grp 2 and Grp 3). Each version has three tasks: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task III (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks). A candidate works on one group only (the printed paper does not say how the groups are allotted).

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (the picture 'CornerShop' found on the desktop, Group Two Task II) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.

Page de garde verifiee : ORDINARY LEVEL, COMPUTER SCIENCE, 0595, Paper 3, juin 2021, 2h30. Transcrites en neuf fichiers : numero_exercice G1-T1, G1-T2, G1-T3, G2-T1, ..., G3-T3 ; groupes ["GROUP 1"], ["GROUP 2"] ou ["GROUP 3"]. Le sujet n'impose pas expressement de ne traiter qu'une version (le candidat ne passe en pratique qu'un groupe) : non exprimable, regles_choix reste vide. De meme, a la Task III le sujet dit « Select any one of them » (programme C ou Pascal) : non exprimable.

Les filigranes gcerevision.com / Kawlo, les cadres d'en-tete (numero de centre, nom du candidat, « For examiners' use only »), les lignes a completer, les textes fantomes du verso (le papier est translucide) et les artefacts de scanner sont ignores. Le fichier-image « CornerShop » (Group Two, Task II) et les fichiers du bureau ne figurent pas dans le PDF.

Aucun logiciel (traitement de texte, tableur) n'a ete execute : les menus et les etapes sont donnes de memoire (Office recent) et ne sont pas testes. Les formules de tableur ont ete traduites en Python et executees sur les donnees du sujet (totaux, moyennes, calcul des frais, tri). Aucun compilateur C ou Pascal n'est disponible : les programmes du sujet n'ont pas ete compiles, leur logique a ete verifiee par une simulation Python fidele (division entiere et reste, memes entrees, memes sorties) dont les resultats sont recopies dans les corriges.
Aucun corrige officiel n'existe : les reponses sont redigees. Les repartitions de points dans les corriges (« marking idea ») sont indicatives ; les points imprimes du sujet ne sont jamais modifies.

Pascal : les entiers du programme sont declares « integer ». Sur un compilateur a entiers de 16 bits (maximum 32767, cas d'anciens Turbo Pascal ou du mode par defaut de certains compilateurs) une entree comme 45678 (Group One) provoque un depassement ; sur un compilateur a entiers de 32 bits (cas usuel, et int en C) le resultat est celui donne. Le corrige indique la sortie attendue sur une machine a entiers de 32 bits. En Pascal ISO la largeur d'affichage par defaut d'un entier est definie par l'implementation : le corrige suppose l'affichage sans blancs de tete (cas usuel).
Task I, Group One : les points imprimes (1 + 1 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 2 = 20) correspondent a l'en-tete ; les questions 2 (launch) et 9 (save and print) n'ont pas de points.

Le « heading of the text » (question 5) n'est pas designe precisement : lu comme la ligne d'objet « Payment of outstanding dues » (premiere ligne de corps du texte, seule ligne qui ressemble a un titre) ; si le jury vise l'en-tete du courrier (« D. Technology Consulting »), la methode est la meme. Le nom du traitement de texte (question 1) depend de la machine : reponse generique. Dans le tableau, la premiere colonne (« S/N ») et le prenom/nom (« Agbor Mary » en ligne 2 : nom de famille Mary, prenom Agbor) sont recopies tels qu'imprimes.

questions.enonce_markdown: State the name of the word processor installed in your computer.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The answer depends on the software installed on the candidate's computer, so give the real name found on that machine, for example **Microsoft Word** (or **LibreOffice Writer**, **WPS Writer**). You can read it in the *Start* menu or in the *About* window of the program. A correct answer names a real word processor, not a spreadsheet or a browser.

Open the word processor named in question 1 (for example *Start* > *Microsoft Word* > *Blank document*, or double-click its icon on the desktop). A new empty document is displayed, ready for typing. No mark is printed for this step.

questions.enonce_markdown: Set the page orientation to Landscape, and the page size to A4.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
In the *Layout* tab (*Page Layout* in older versions), *Page Setup* group:

1. click **Orientation** and choose **Landscape**;
2. click **Size** and choose **A4** (21 cm x 29.7 cm).

The page is now wider than it is tall (29.7 cm wide, 21 cm high). Do this before typing, so that the text is laid out on the right page.

questions.enonce_markdown: Type the text given in Figure 1.  *[4 marks]*

Format the heading of the text as follows:

a. Font size: 18
b. Font name: Arial
c. Alignment: Centre
d. Case: Upper case  *[4 marks]*

Format the rest of the text as follows:

a. Font size: 13
b. Line spacing: 1.5
c. Alignment: Full justification
d. Font name: Times New Roman  *[4 marks]*
Insert Table 1 before the signature of the Director.  *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. Click at the end of the last paragraph (*...identification papers.*) and press *Enter* to leave a blank line, so that the insertion point is just **before** the closing lines *The Director of Finance* / *D. Technology Consulting* (the Director's signature block).
2. *Insert* tab > **Table** > **Insert Table**: **6 columns** and **6 rows** (one header row and five data rows).
3. Type the header row: *S/N, TITLE, FIRST NAME, LAST NAME, TEAM LEADER, DATE*.
4. Type the five rows exactly as printed in Table 1 (*1. Mr Julius Agbor IT solutions 5th August 2001* ... *5. Mr Richard Magnus IT security 27th August 2001*). Use *Tab* to move from cell to cell. The ordinal endings *th* may be superscript (as printed) or normal text.
5. Make sure the table has visible borders (*Table Design* > *Borders* > *All Borders*) and fits within the margins.

The table now appears between the text and the signature of the Director.

questions.enonce_markdown: Add header " D. Consulting" and footer "Outstanding Payment".  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. *Insert* tab > **Header** > **Edit Header** (or double-click at the top margin of the page). Type **D. Consulting** and close the header (*Close Header and Footer*).
2. *Insert* tab > **Footer** > **Edit Footer** (or double-click at the bottom margin). Type **Outstanding Payment** and close.

The header appears at the top and the footer at the bottom of every page. One mark for the header, one mark for the footer.

questions.enonce_markdown: Save your work as Task 1 in your working directory and print a copy.
questions.corrige_markdown: *File* > **Save As**, browse to your working directory (the folder named by the supervisor, usually the *Candidate folder*), type the file name **Task 1** and click *Save*. Then *File* > **Print** (*Ctrl + P*), check the preview (landscape, A4) and print one copy; insert the printed copy in the question booklet. No mark is printed for these steps.
